const p="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+import json, os, sys, time
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT='/app/output'
+CAMERAS=['robot0_agentview_center','robot0_eye_in_hand']
+
+def action(arm=(0,0,0), grip=-1, base=(0,0,0), torso=0, mode=-1):
+    a=np.zeros(12,dtype=np.float64)
+    a[:3]=arm; a[6]=grip; a[7:10]=base; a[10]=torso; a[11]=mode
+    return a
+
+def send(robot, rows, name, cams=CAMERAS, depth=True):
+    a=np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float64)
+    if a.ndim==1: a=a[None,:]
+    result=robot.submit('ee_delta',a,interpolate='hold',cameras=cams,
+                        include_depth=depth,video='none',note=name)
+    result.save(f'{OUT}/{name}')
+    p=result.meta['proprio']
+    d=dict(zip(p['layout'],p['now']))
+    print(name,'eef',*[round(d['eef_right_'+v],4) for v in 'xyz'],
+          'fingers',round(d['gripper0_right_finger_joint1_pos'],4),
+          round(d['gripper0_right_finger_joint2_pos'],4),
+          'time left',round(result.meta['time_left_s']),flush=True)
+    return result
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    r=Robot()
+    cmd=sys.argv[1]
+    name=sys.argv[2]
+    n=int(sys.argv[3])
+    vals=[float(x) for x in sys.argv[4:]]
+    if cmd=='arm': a=action(arm=vals[:3],grip=vals[3] if len(vals)>3 else -1)
+    elif cmd=='base': a=action(base=vals[:3],grip=vals[3] if len(vals)>3 else -1,mode=1)
+    elif cmd=='grip': a=action(grip=vals[0])
+    else: raise ValueError(cmd)
+    send(r,np.tile(a,(n,1)),name)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(p))
